items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions Flip Wilson (corrected from Flip Phillips) only in the context of a comedian whose routine inspired Leon's act; there is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship between Ernie Fields and Flip Phillips.

ctx.x: passed. He had a little act that he and Leon used to do together. Leon would put on a dress and they used to do this--remember when Smoke That Cigarette--some country and western band had that--but anyway we had a novelty deal on that and Leon and Harold--Geesil--would put on this act, Leon would have on a dress and so one time I asked him, how did you think of that. He said I used to do this for years and he said-- what's this big comedian--
